name: Santana Minerals Limited
quirks: ASX-primary dual listing; company IR at santanaminerals.com; annualreports.com is a third-party fallback only. Pre-revenue single-asset gold developer (Bendigo-Ophir, Central Otago NZ); reports in AUD whole dollars while NZX line quotes NZD. Share history restated for a 1:70 consolidation (Oct 2020) and a 3:1 split (Oct 2024) - the FY2025 report's "1-for-40" footnote is a drafting error. Valued by risked project-NPV, not owner-FCF; hinges on the Fast-track permit decision due 16 Dec 2026.
